Baseline Characteristics Table

Source: vignettes/baseline-character.Rmd
baseline-character.Rmd
library(metalite)
library(metalite.sl)

Create Baseline Characteristic Table

The baseline characteristic analysis aims to provide tables to summarize details of participants. The development of baseline characteristic analysis involves functions:

  • prepare_base_char: prepare analysis raw datasets.
  • format_base_char: prepare analysis outdata with proper format.
  • rtf_base_char: transfer output dataset to RTF table.

Build a metadata 

adsl <- r2rtf::r2rtf_adsl
adsl$TRTA <- adsl$TRT01A
adsl$TRTA <- factor(
  adsl$TRTA,
  levels = c("Placebo", "Xanomeline Low Dose", "Xanomeline High Dose"),
  labels = c("Placebo", "Low Dose", "High Dose")
)
meta <- metalite::meta_adam(
  population = adsl,
  observation = adsl
) |>
  metalite::define_plan(plan = metalite::plan(
    analysis = "base_char",
    population = "apat",
    observation = "apat",
    parameter = "age;gender;race"
  )) |>
  metalite::define_population(
    name = "apat",
    group = "TRTA",
    subset = SAFFL == "Y",
    var = names(adsl),
    label = "All Participants as Treated"
  ) |>
  metalite::define_observation(
    name = "apat",
    group = "TRTA",
    subset = SAFFL == "Y",
    var = names(adsl),
    label = ""
  ) |>
  metalite::define_parameter(
    name = "age",
    var = "AGE",
    vargroup = "AGEGR1",
    label = attr(adsl$AGE, "label")
  ) |>
  metalite::define_parameter(
    name = "gender",
    var = "SEX",
    label = attr(adsl$SEX, "label")
  ) |>
  metalite::define_parameter(
    name = "race",
    var = "RACE",
    label = attr(adsl$RACE, "label")
  ) |>
  metalite::define_analysis(
    name = "base_char",
    label = "",
    title = "Participant Baseline Characteristics by Treatment Group"
  ) |>
  metalite::meta_build()

Analysis preparation

The input of the function prepare_base_char() is a meta object created by the metalite package.

outdata <- meta |>
  prepare_base_char(parameter = "age;gender;race")

outdata

Format the numbers

format_base_char to prepare analysis dataset before generate RTF output

outdata <-
  outdata |> format_base_char(
    display_col = c("n", "prop", "total"),
    digits_prop = 2
  )

Output as RTF

rtf_base_char to generate RTF output

outdata |> rtf_base_char(
  source = "Source: [CDISCpilot: adam-adsl]",
  path_outdata = tempfile(fileext = ".Rdata"),
  path_outtable = "outtable/base0char.rtf"
)
## The outdata is saved in/tmp/RtmpWjPwhF/file1c257fcfcb99.Rdata
## The output is saved in/home/runner/work/metalite.sl/metalite.sl/vignettes/outtable/base0char.rtf
